_origin: Field names copied by hand from the TrueNAS middleware API models in src/middlewared/middlewared/api/v25_10_0/directory_services.py and v27_0_0/directory_services.py (the models of directoryservices.update and directoryservices.leave are identical in both versions; the other differences concern status, keytab sync and docstrings). Source: github.com/truenas/middleware. When a newer middleware version changes these models, update this file from the source first, then the tool: tools/directoryservices_followups_test.go (TestDirectoryServiceSchemaPinnedToMiddlewareModel and TestLeaveDirectoryServicePinnedToMiddlewareModel) fails if the tool's schema and handler drift from it.

update._model: DirectoryServicesUpdateArgs (DirectoryServicesEntry without id, plus force; every field optional, ForUpdateMetaclass)

ACTIVEDIRECTORY._model: ActiveDirectoryConfig (service_type is excluded from the payload)

update._idmap_secret_fields: Secret[...] fields of the idmap models nested in ActiveDirectoryConfig.idmap.idmap_domain and ActiveDirectoryConfig.trusted_domains[], by idmap_backend
